subprocess_flow.substep_name: Submit Automated Intake & Use Case Concept
subprocess_flow.description: The AI Project Lead completes and submits the initial project documentation using the MoJ self-service registration intake form. Pre-validated metadata schema fields automatically parse and verify use case attributes, target operational environments, and high-level architecture against enterprise baseline standards to minimize registration delays and identify low-risk candidates for fast-track processing.
outputs: Automated Self-Service Intake Form with Pre-Validated Metadata
success_criteria: Automated self-service form successfully validated against metadata schemas
Intake tiering report generated with baseline risk scoring
No mandatory intake fields left blank or invalid
subprocess_flow.purpose: Capture standardized AI use case metadata rapidly and determine immediate eligibility for fast-track triage.
subprocess_flow.scope: Submission of project parameters and initial concept artifacts across any MoJ business unit.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Initiation of a new algorithmic system or AI project proposal
end_conditions: Receipt of complete intake package and automated validation receipt

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incomplete or inaccurate metadata entry bypassing initial automated checks
step_risks_and_controls.control: Pre-validated input schemas with automated syntax, entity verification, and mandatory field enforcement

governance_requirements: CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) Tiering

change_management.change_request_process: Use case modifications prior to gate review require updated intake form re-submission

subprocess_flow.description: The Data Protection Officer and Information Asset Owner evaluate all proposed datasets against HMG Government Security Classifications. This evaluation identifies sensitive offender, victim, and judicial records, establishes whether data must be handled under OFFICIAL or OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE protocols, and issues the formal Data Classification Certificate governing storage and compute isolation boundaries.
inputs: Automated Self-Service Intake Form with Pre-Validated Metadata
dependencies: Submit Automated Intake & Use Case Concept
success_criteria: Formal classification assigned under HMG Government Security Classifications
Special category and criminal justice data elements clearly tagged and isolated
Sign-off provided by the designated Information Asset Owner
subprocess_flow.purpose: Ensure all justice datasets ingested into AI pipelines have explicit security controls and boundary specifications.
subprocess_flow.scope: All structured and unstructured data assets proposed for training, fine-tuning, or inference.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Generation of Automated Intake Tiering Report
end_conditions: Issuance of signed Data Classification Certificate

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Inadvertent exposure of sensitive offender or witness records due to improper security tiering
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory IAO review and cryptographic tagging of data assets prior to data pipeline provisioning

governance_requirements: Data Protection Act 2018 Part 3 (Law Enforcement Processing)

change_management.change_request_process: Dataset additions or alterations submitted to IAO via Data Governance change ticket
change_management.versioning_rules: Data Classification Assessment version incremented (e.g., v0.2)

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Evaluate Regulatory Risk Tiers & Initiate ATRS
subprocess_flow.description: The AI Project Lead and Enterprise Architect map the AI system's functionality against the EU AI Act risk tiers and the NIST AI RMF Profile to determine statutory obligations. High-risk judicial use cases—such as predictive recidivism assessment or sentencing support—are tagged for mandatory full lifecycle governance, while low-risk operational tools are routed through fast-track triage templates and pre-populated into the CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard draft.
outputs: NIST / EU AI Act Risk Tier Classification
success_criteria: Accurate classification against EU AI Act criteria (Unacceptable, High, Limited, Minimal)
NIST AI RMF profile mapped with specific risk mitigations defined
subprocess_flow.purpose: Identify statutory regulatory duties early to establish the appropriate governance pathway and eliminate delivery bottlenecks.
subprocess_flow.scope: Algorithmic decision boundaries, intended user interactions, and cross-regulatory exposure.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
end_conditions: Sign-off of the Risk Tier Classification document

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Mischaracterization of a high-risk judicial algorithmic system as low-risk to avoid governance
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated cross-check against statutory high-risk use case lists and MoJ Enterprise Architecture validation

governance_requirements: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

change_management.change_request_process: Scope or model capability changes require re-evaluation of the risk tier matrix
change_management.versioning_rules: Risk Tier Dossier versioned as v0.3

improvement_inputs: UK AISI and international AI safety policy updates

subprocess_flow.description: The Data Protection Officer conducts a preliminary Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) under UK GDPR Article 35. This assessment determines whether the AI system involves automated profiling, processing of special category justice data, or systemic public monitoring, defining the required privacy-enhancing technologies and legal bases needed before technical development commences.
inputs: NIST / EU AI Act Risk Tier Classification
dependencies: Evaluate Regulatory Risk Tiers & Initiate ATRS
success_criteria: Article 35 screening checklist completed and signed by DPO
Privacy and surveillance impact thresholds established
Mandatory data protection controls documented for project implementation
subprocess_flow.purpose: Assess data privacy risks and ensure legal defensibility under UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
subprocess_flow.scope: Personal data flows, algorithmic decision effects on data subjects, and statutory compliance boundaries.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
end_conditions: Formal approval of the Preliminary DPIA screening

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Unlawful processing of citizen or offender personal data without required legal basis or DPIA
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory DPO gateway checkpoint blocking project advancement without an approved Preliminary DPIA

governance_requirements: ICO AI and Data Protection Guidance

change_management.change_request_process: Modifications to personal data processing triggers full DPIA remediation

improvement_inputs: ICO enforcement decisions and regulatory advisories

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Dual Architecture & IAO Sign-Off & Registry Logging
subprocess_flow.description: MoJ Enterprise Architecture and the Information Asset Owner review the consolidated inception dossier, comprising the registration form, data classification certificate, risk tiering, and preliminary DPIA. Upon dual approval, the project is officially recorded in the centralized MoJ AI Registry, assigned a unique tracking identifier, and authorized to proceed to the Data Quality and Provenance stage.
inputs: NIST / EU AI Act Risk Tier Classification
success_criteria: Dual digital sign-off completed by Enterprise Architecture and IAO
AI use case assigned a unique ID in the MoJ Centralised AI Registry
Comprehensive Inception & Classification dossier baselined at v1.0
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide authoritative governance registration and establish formal auditability prior to technical execution.
subprocess_flow.scope: Final consolidation, validation, and system registration across enterprise repositories.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Submission of complete preliminary compliance and classification pack
end_conditions: Inception dossier marked approved and registered in MoJ AI Registry

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Unsanctioned development of shadow AI systems without enterprise visibility or audit logging
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory cryptographic registry record required to provision cloud infrastructure access and service accounts

governance_requirements: Central Digital and Data Office (CDDO) Standards

change_management.change_request_process: Post-registration scope changes require formal change submission to Enterprise Architecture via Jira/ServiceNow
change_management.versioning_rules: Final Inception Dossier locked and baselined as v1.0

improvement_inputs: Dual sign-off lead times and reviewer bottlenecks
